name: Naches Heights
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Warm days and cool nights keep acid and sugar in balance, and the long season lets tannins mature.

blurb.text: A small Columbia Valley AVA in Washington's Yakima County, on the western edge of the Columbia Basin. All its vineyards are farmed organically, biodynamically or Salmon-Safe, and its top grapes are Pinot Gris, Riesling, Gewürztraminer and Syrah.
